newsitem.title: USA: Iridex gets FDA OK to market DioLite 532.
newsitem.headline: Iridex gets FDA OK to market DioLite 532.

text.p: IRIDEX Corp said Monday it received 510 clearance from the U.S. Foot and Drug Administration to market and sell its new DioLite 532 laser system for the treatment of vascular and pigmented skin lesions.
The DioLite 532 is a semiconductor-based all-solid-state laser product available for dermatology.

IRIDEX said it is leveraging its technology into new markets using the same approach it used in ophthalmology by offering a device that is smaller and significantly less expensive than competitive units.
Shipments of the DioLite 532 are expected to begin during the third quarter of 1997, the company said.
